title: Glassjaw Whelp
text: Glassjaw Whelp tests fresh crystal teeth against armor seams before the larger brood arrives. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Each broken tooth becomes another egg.

defeatReward.text: Glassjaw Whelp is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
